detail.not_found_desc: It may have been removed, or the link is incorrect. Explore our other Vietnam journeys from the tour list.
detail.faq_1_a: We follow the cancellation terms shown at booking. Cancellations made within the free window are refunded to your original payment method; otherwise a fee may apply. You’ll receive status updates by email.
detail.faq_2_q: Can I change the travel date?
detail.faq_2_a: Yes — contact us at least 7 days before departure. We’ll check availability and confirm any fare difference or fees.
detail.faq_3_q: My discount code isn’t working. What should I do?
detail.faq_3_a: Check the code’s expiry and conditions. If it still fails, our support team can apply it manually when possible.
detail.faq_4_a: It depends on your passport and the regions you visit. We recommend checking your embassy and our support team for the latest rules.
detail.faq_5_a: Some packages include basic coverage. Details are listed in your tour inclusions; you can add travel insurance for extra protection.

contact.title: Contact
contact.hero_subtitle: Questions about bookings, tours, or partnerships? Our team in Vietnam is ready to help.
contact.subtitle: We're here to listen and support you.
contact.map_desc: Our main office is in the capital. Drop by during business hours or schedule a call — we love talking travel.
contact.faq_subtitle: Common questions before you write to us.
contact.faq1_a: We usually reply within 24 hours on business days. Urgent booking issues: call our hotline.
contact.faq2_q: Can I change or cancel a booking?
contact.faq2_a: It depends on the hotel or tour policy. Open your booking in the app or contact us with your reservation ID.
contact.faq3_q: Do you support English and Vietnamese?
contact.faq3_a: Yes. Our support team is bilingual and happy to help in either language.
contact.faq4_a: We use industry-standard payment partners and never store your full card number on our servers.
contact.cta_explore_title: Prefer to explore on your own?

contact.form_intro: Fill in the form below and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
